newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romanian retail sales rise 3.7 pct in May.
newsitem.headline: Romanian retail sales rise 3.7 pct in May.

text.p: Romania's retail sales rose by 3.7 percent in real terms in May from the previous month, recovering after four months of decline, National Statistics Board (CNS) data showed on Wednesday.
ROMANIAN RETAIL SALES MAY 97 APRIL 97 MAY 96
NOTES -- Year-on-year and month-on-month changes in comparable prices.
The CNS said sales of non-food items, especially cars and fuel, saw a strong recovery, rising by 5.4 percent in May from April.
It said private companies accounted for 69.3 percent of retail trade turnover, which was 29.2 percent down in January-May this year from the year ago period.
